ui.Search an area, station or place\u2026: ابحث عن منطقة أو محطة أو مكان…
ui.tips: اضغط على أي خط لإظهاره أو إخفائه · مرّر على محطة أو منطقة لمعرفة اسمها · اضغط على مكان أو منطقة لعرض التفاصيل · قرّب لرؤية المدارس والمستشفيات وأسماء المناطق
ui.legtip: اضغط على أي عنصر أدناه لإظهاره أو إخفائه على الخريطة. استخدم «إظهار الكل» / «إخفاء الكل» للتبديل دفعة واحدة.
ui.note: المسافة بالكيلومتر = خط مستقيم. مدة القيادة المعتادة بالسيارة أيام الأسبوع بالدقائق من خرائط Google: الصباح = 8 صباحاً، إلى الوجهة · الظهر = 11 صباحاً · المساء = الأسوأ بين 3:30 و6 مساءً، عودة إلى المشروع · آخر الليل = 3 فجراً. الأحمر والبرتقالي = ساعات الذروة، الأصفر = حركة عادية، الأخضر = طرق فارغة. الطرق السريعة: الوقت للوصول إلى أقرب نقطة على الطريق.
ui.title: الطرق والسكك والأماكن حول
ui.sub: البنية التحتية الحالية والمخطط لها، المناطق، المدارس، المستشفيات والمعالم.

Jebel Ali First.d: Residential district by Ibn Battuta and the Red Line around The Gardens, Discovery Gardens and Jebel Ali Village, mostly villas, townhouses and low-rise homes.
p: Urban area (coast to E611): where all of Dubai's planned growth to 2040 is concentrated, with higher density near transit.

Warsan 2.d: Low-rise district near International City and Dragon Mart off Ras Al Khor Road (E44) and Emirates Road (E611), mainly service, storage and housing plots.
p: Urban area (coast to E611): where all of Dubai's planned growth to 2040 is concentrated, with higher density near transit.

Wadi Al Safa 7.d: Dubailand district off Al Qudra Road around Arabian Ranches 2, The Sustainable City, Layan, Rukan and Serena, with villas, townhouses and some apartments.
p: Urban area (coast to E611): where all of Dubai's planned growth to 2040 is concentrated, with higher density near transit.

Meydan One.d: Meydan's mixed-use district between Al Khail Road and Ras Al Khor Road with Azizi Riviera, a crystal lagoon and the planned Meydan One Mall.
p: Urban area (coast to E611): where all of Dubai's planned growth to 2040 is concentrated, with higher density near transit.

Wadi Al Safa 5.d: Dubailand district near the E311 and Al Ain Road with villa and townhouse clusters around Villanova, The Villa and Haven.
p: Urban area (coast to E611): where all of Dubai's planned growth to 2040 is concentrated, with higher density near transit.

Emirates Living.d: The rest of Emaar's Emirates Living master community: the land between Emirates Hills, The Lakes, The Meadows and The Springs.
p: Urban area (coast to E611): where all of Dubai's planned growth to 2040 is concentrated, with higher density near transit.

Al Barsha.d: Part of the wider Al Barsha district between Al Barsha 2, Al Barsha 3 and Al Barsha South, with villas, schools and community services.
p: Urban area (coast to E611): where all of Dubai's planned growth to 2040 is concentrated, with higher density near transit.

Mina Rashid (Rashid Yachts & Marina).d: The former Port Rashid, now Emaar's waterfront district with the cruise terminal, the QE2 hotel ship, a superyacht marina and new homes.
p: Cruise-terminal district: the plan links the terminal with nearby hotels and retail to create a hospitality-focused mixed-use area.
On the coastal tourism corridor, with planned public-realm upgrades, transit links and continuous public beach access along the coast.
Urban area (coast to E611): where all of Dubai's planned growth to 2040 is concentrated, with higher density near transit.

La Mer (incl. Port De La Mer).d: Meraas beachfront district in Jumeirah 1 with restaurants, a waterpark and public beach, plus the Port De La Mer homes and marina.
p: On the coastal tourism corridor, with planned public-realm upgrades, transit links and continuous public beach access along the coast.
Urban area (coast to E611): where all of Dubai's planned growth to 2040 is concentrated, with higher density near transit.

Reem (Mira & Mira Oasis).d: Emaar's gated townhouse community next to Arabian Ranches, made up of Mira, Mira Oasis and Reem, with a large central park.
p: Peri-urban area (beyond E611): planned for low-to-medium density and future mixed use; much of it is land bank released only after 2040 land is used up.

dso_exp.t: AED 12.8bn Silicon Oasis expansion launched: 'District IO' tech district for 6,500+ companies (AI, robotics, quantum) and 'Block 14' transit-oriented district by the Blue Line station, due 2029.

blue.t: Metro Blue Line under construction (14 stations, opens 2029). Tunnelling started; a tunnel boring machine reached the Dragon Mart station site in July 2026.

blue_mirdif.t: Blue Line branch from Centrepoint through Mirdif and Al Warqa to International City 1 (4 stations); RTA briefed Mirdif and Al Warqa residents on progress and traffic diversions.

blue_creek.t: World's tallest metro station (74 m) being built at Dubai Creek Harbour on the Blue Line, with the metro's first bridge across the Creek; due 2029.

square.t: Emaar's Dubai Square mall under construction in Creek Harbour, linked to the redesigned Dubai Creek Tower; opening expected around 2028.

jvc_roads.t: RTA–Dubai Holding AED 6bn programme adds four new access points to JVC, doubling entry/exit capacity; a separate AED 1.5bn Al Fay Street project adds bridges into JVC (phases by 2027 and 2028).

skylight.t: Dubai Retail's Skylight Mall on Al Khail Road: 1.3m sq ft, 360+ stores, serving JVT, Jumeirah Islands and The Springs; opening 2027.

dwc.t: Al Maktoum International Airport phase 1 on track for 2032 (150m passengers a year); AED 13bn of contracts under way and AED 55bn more to be awarded.

expo.t: Expo City Dubai's first homes: Expo Valley villas/townhouses (phase 1 due Jan 2026) and Expo Central apartments, with car-free lanes and cycle routes, part of the Dubai 2040 plan.

dubaimall.t: Dubai Mall expansion: 'The District' (279 outlets) and a 440,000 sq ft Grand Drive extension targeted for H2 2028.

moe.t: Mall of the Emirates AED 5bn upgrade: first outdoor F&B courtyard (early 2027) and four new entertainment concepts (late 2026).

alquoz.t: Al Quoz Creative Zone masterplan: grow creatives from 900 to 20,000, +30% commercial space and housing for 8,000; Alserkal Avenue anchors the district.

gold.t: Ithra launched the Dubai Gold District in Deira; phase 1 of its wider Deira Enrichment Project spans 36 plots from the Hyatt Regency to Shindagha.

islands.t: Nakheel upgrading 3 km of Dubai Islands' western shoreline with a new beach by Bay Villas (636 homes), due Q4 2027; AED 527m Island B infrastructure contract.

palm.t: Nakheel launched 16 beachfront Podium Villas at Palm Beach Towers on Palm Jumeirah, with handover in H1 2027.

pja.t: Nakheel says Palm Jebel Ali's first villa handovers start later in 2026, with the island opening in phases rather than on a single date.

harbour.t: The new bridge linking Sheikh Zayed Road with Dubai Harbour opened its first phase on 19 June 2026 and was about 90% complete; Arada awarded the AED 1.55bn W Residences main contract (490 homes) in February 2026.

hessa.t: Hessa Street upgrade completed: widened to 4 lanes each way with four rebuilt junctions, doubling capacity; phase 2 started.

umm_suqeim_st.t: Umm Suqeim Street works ~70% complete between Al Khail Rd and E311, part of the 16 km Umm Suqeim–Al Qudra corridor.

gold_line.t: Metro Gold Line approved: 42 km underground, 18 stations from Al Ghubaiba via City Walk, Business Bay, Meydan, Al Barsha South and JVC to Jumeirah Golf Estates, opening 9 Sep 2032.

etihad_dxb.t: Etihad Rail's Dubai passenger station at Al Yalayis (Jumeirah Golf Estates) opened 30 Sep 2026, linked by footbridge to the metro.

etihad_shj.t: Etihad Rail Sharjah station near University City scheduled to open around March 2027.

hsr.t: Abu Dhabi–Dubai high-speed rail planned with Dubai stations at Al Jaddaf and near Al Maktoum Airport (about 30 minutes to Abu Dhabi).

fourth.t: Fourth Corridor approved: about 80 km, 12-lane road from Al Shanouf Road (Sharjah) to Al Faya Road (Abu Dhabi); phase 1 covers about 30 km from Al Shanouf Road to Dubai–Al Ain Road.

liwan_mall.t: Le Meryeme Mall – Liwan (KeyMavens) with LuLu Hypermarket as anchor, on track for Q4 2026 completion.

sobha_mall.t: AED 210m Sobha Mall in Sobha Hartland due H2 2026, with a supermarket, gym, indoor play/entertainment zone and about 35 shops and restaurants.

plaza.t: Former Lamcy Plaza reopening as 'The Plaza' after renovation, expected H1 2027.

azizi.t: Burj Azizi (725 m) under construction on Sheikh Zayed Road, set to be the world's second-tallest tower; completion expected 2028.

creektower.t: Dubai Creek Tower being redesigned; in June 2026 Emaar delayed the construction tender by about 3–4 months, citing higher material costs.

loop.t: The Boring Company's Dubai Loop pilot (6.4 km, 4 stations) linking DIFC and Dubai Mall is under contract; tunnelling targeted for H2 2026.

theloop.t: URB's 'The Loop' proposal: a 93 km climate-controlled walking and cycling corridor around the city (concept, not yet approved).

qudra.t: Al Qudra Road upgrade: new bridges at the Arabian Ranches/Studio City link (Feb 2026) and at Sheikh Zayed bin Hamdan St (Aug 2026) cut junction waiting times by up to 85%; side ramp bridges due Q4 2026.

qudra_e611.t: A service road and free-flow loop ramp at the Emirates Road–Al Qudra Road junction were completed in May 2026; the project also plans to widen 3.4 km of Al Qudra Road to the roundabout serving Town Square, Mira and DAMAC Hills 2.

nas.t: RTA building a 32 km internal road network in Nad Al Sheba 1, 3 and 4 with 15 km of walking and cycling tracks and landscaping; NAS 3 and 4 due early 2027.

awir.t: RTA upgrading the Sheikh Zayed bin Hamdan St / Al Awir Rd / Al Manama St junction, raising capacity from 5,200 to 14,400 vehicles/hour; due Q3 2028.

jafza.t: Jafza attracted AED 854m of new investment in Jan–Apr 2026, with over 43% of commitments signed in March and April.

e611_north.t: Emirates Road widened from 6 to 8 lanes on a 5 km stretch from the Sharjah border toward Wadi Al Amardi (opened Aug 2026), cutting peak-hour travel time by up to 25%.

khawaneej.t: Six km of new internal roads completed in Al Khawaneej 2 (Sheikh Zayed Housing Programme – Tolerance District), linked to Amman Street.

route2020.t: Red Line Route 2020 stations (The Gardens, Discovery Gardens, Al Furjan, Jumeirah Golf Estates, DIP, Expo City) serve the area; Jumeirah Golf Estates links to the Etihad Rail passenger station.

usq_corr.t: RTA awarded the Umm Suqeim, Al Wasl and Al Safa streets project: about 11 km of bridges and tunnels, cutting the Jumeirah Street to Al Khail Road trip from about 20 to 6 minutes.

rd18.t: RTA finished 13 km of new road links in 18 residential areas (incl. Al Satwa, Al Hudaiba, Za'abeel 1, Jumeirah 1, Umm Suqeim 1, Al Twar 1, Muhaisnah 1, Al Mizhar, Al Khawaneej 1), cutting local journeys by up to 40%.

rd19.t: RTA building 11.5 km of road connections in 19 residential areas (incl. Al Qusais 2, Al Twar 1, Muhaisnah 1): new links, roadside parking, pavements and lighting; due Q2 2026.

damac.t: DAMAC targets 8,800+ handovers in 2026; DAMAC Lagoons alone about 6,300 homes, with infrastructure and landscaping more than 80% complete.

minarashid.t: Emaar and P&O Marinas' Mina Rashid master plan (about AED 25bn): 430 wet berths, the QE2 as centrepiece, a beach, hotels and a waterfront retail district.

mamzar.t: Revamped Al Mamzar Lagoon Beach drew 1.75m+ visitors since opening in May 2026; the Corniche phase adds a women-only beach.

mushrif.t: Mushrif National Park: a new 102 m bridge links previously separate sections of the mountain-bike trail, with separate paths for cyclists and pedestrians; a 1.5 km Young Rangers trail for children under 12 opened in Dec 2025.

valley.t: Emaar's The Valley phase 2: 200 hectares and 4,500+ homes on the Dubai–Al Ain Road.

latifa.t: AED 2bn contract awarded for the 12 km Latifa bint Hamdan Corridor serving Nad Al Sheba, Al Barari, Dubai Hills and nearby areas.

jlt.t: DMCC launched an all-electric 'JLT Link' bus between JLT and Uptown Dubai (from 1 Aug 2026); planned One and Two Uptown Place towers will add 560,000+ sq ft of offices by 2028.

dh_roads.t: RTA and Dubai Holding signed an AED 6bn road programme to improve access to Dubai Holding communities, including Jumeirah Park and Dubai Production City.

khail1.t: RTA is seeking contractors for a roughly 30 km road scheme parallel to Sheikh Zayed Road, including about 15 km of viaduct along First Al Khail Street; expressions of interest were due 10 October 2026.

jbeach1.t: Jumeirah Beach 1 revamp (1.4 km, beach 50% larger) with walking, jogging and cycling tracks and smart services, part of Dubai's beach development plan.

bulgari.t: Bvlgari Lighthouse on Jumeira Bay: AED 850m construction contract, penthouse-only tower due around Q2 2027.

heart_eu.t: The Heart of Europe at The World Islands targets end-2027, about 52% built; plans include 20 hotels.

ain.t: Ain Dubai, the world's tallest observation wheel, reopened after a two-year closure.

hassyan.t: DEWA's Hassyan seawater desalination plant (818,000 m³/day, solar-powered) passed 90% on phase 1; all phases due Q1 2027.

shindagha.t: Al Shindagha Corridor finished on the Bur Dubai side, giving free flow from Al Garhoud Bridge via Infinity Bridge to Port Rashid; corridor travel time cut from 80 to 12 minutes.

satwa.t: More freehold options opening in historic Satwa for property buyers.

szr_lane.t: New lane by Dubai Mall metro station: 2 km Sheikh Zayed Road widening adds 17% capacity, up to 10% faster at rush hour.

dxb.t: DXB now expects about 70m passengers in 2026 (31.5m in H1) after disruption from the regional conflict; 100m targeted by end-2027 as growth later shifts to Al Maktoum.

azizi_riv.t: Azizi handed over Riviera 69 and Beachfront I (667 homes) at Azizi Riviera in MBR City; Riviera 69 is the eighth completed Phase 4 building, taking progress to 74%.

majan.t: Drake & Scull and Prestige One started work on a new Majan project, due Q1 2028.

sobha_sanct.t: Sobha launched the AED 50bn Sobha Sanctuary master community; first handovers from Q3 2029.

jebelali_port.t: Jebel Ali Port volumes fell almost 60% in H1 2026 to 3.1m TEU amid Strait of Hormuz disruption, dropping it out of the global top 30.
